responses.text: I found a lot of November work, and I need to know how you want it handled before I propose anything.

tool_calls.name: ask_user

args.question: November has many items, including about 25 recurring series (like Standup, Gym, Torah study) and dozens of one-time tasks, and I can't see every one because the agenda truncates each day. Which should I move to December?
options: One-time tasks only, same day in December (e.g. Nov 10 → Dec 10)
One-time tasks only, but I'll confirm each date
Recurring series too: end them Oct 31 and restart on Dec 1
Cancel, I only wanted a specific task
